program:
alphabet a b c

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
is_c = symbol c
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_a@i & !is_bos@j & !is_b@j, !is_a@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & !is_b@j & is_c@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(is_bos@i & !is_b@i & is_c@i & h1_1@i & is_bos@j & is_a@j & is_b@j & is_c@j & h1_1@j, is_bos@i & is_c@i & h1_1@i & is_bos@j & is_a@j & is_b@j & h1_1@j)
h3_1 = rightmost(!is_a@i & !is_b@i & is_c@i & !h2_1@i, !is_a@i & !is_b@i & is_c@i)
accept = !is_bos & !is_c & !h1_1 & !h3_1

output accept
